semantics.clock: positive edge, explicitly required by original final sentence
semantics.load: At each positive edge, if load is asserted q becomes data, from original load instruction; takes priority over evolution
semantics.evolution: Otherwise q_next[i] = q_old[i-1] XOR q_old[i+1], simultaneously for all 512 cells
semantics.boundaries: q[-1] and q[512] are zero, explicitly stated
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified; none added
semantics.initialization: Original does not specify initial q; no initialization added, simulation starts unknown until loaded
semantics.latency: State updates at the same rising edge; one evolution per cycle; no extra pipeline

numeric.arithmetic: No signed arithmetic, rounding, saturation or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent per-cell loop using original neighbor equation and explicit boundary conditions
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges; compare before rising edge and one time unit after rising edge to allow nonblocking updates
cases: unknown startup observation without prescribing a hardware power-up value
single-cell seeds at both boundaries and middle
deterministic random states and multi-cycle evolution
no updates on input change or falling edges

specification_ambiguities.evidence: No reset or initialization specified in original interface or behavior
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Leave q uninitialized; functional evolution checks begin with a load.
